meaning: GET config uses the active Console credential; default server is opencode.ai/console. No bulk external-key upload occurs in this request.
Console config accepts provider configuration and optional MCP/policies.
Remote provider/model package, headers and settings enter the provider catalog. Integration is set to opencode.
Provider and model package fields accept optional strings.
Known packages use builtins; other names resolve locally or are installed through the Npm service before import.
Dynamic import runs before checking that the module exports model().
The import helper directly calls import(o); resolution returns a file URL.
Arborist uses ignoreScripts:true during installation. That does not suppress the subsequent provider import.
Selected model resolution obtains a package, constructs the model, and supplies the selected credential as apiKey/authToken/accessToken.
ModelResolver provides the Npm service to Provider.loadPackage.
Credential.create stores JSON in the local database; inspected log fields are identifiers and credential type.
Legacy auth.json entries are validated and inserted into the local credential table.
Anthropic API key is passed through the provider x-api-key header.
The default Anthropic endpoint is api.anthropic.com/v1.
OTLP log/trace exporters require an endpoint; default configuration takes it from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.
Desktop renderer initializes Sentry error reporting. Breadcrumbs are filtered; this call has no explicit credential collection or custom beforeSend redactor.
Electron native crash reporter starts with uploadToServer:false.
Renderer has contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false and sandbox:true.
Preload exposes bootstrap, storage/extension snapshots, a message port and getPathForFile.
